pairs.why: B's gloves are big, soft, rounded forms with a gentle sheen like the real pair, while A's are smaller and glossier, with a plastic, statue-like shine.
A is glossier and shows the open cuff holes, so its build looks odd; B has the smoother, softer padded finish of the real gloves.
B keeps the simple scene and red lid exterior of the real cooler with a soft, smooth finish, while A adds extra beach props and a white lid and looks busier and more like a toy.
A matches the real red lid and plain boxy body, while B has a white lid, added feet and a glossier, rounder plastic look.
B has the real card's red lid exterior and a simpler, softer body, while A has a white lid, feet and a more toy-like build.
Both put a thick blue rim on the target, which the real card lacks, but B's thicker, glossier disc and chunkier shelf push it further toward a toy look than A.
B adds extra props, a brick wall, a more saturated glossy finish and an open-mouthed bear, while A stays closer to the real card's simple target and bear.
